metadata.author: transcribed from live/runs by expansion agent
metadata.key_test: The 're-suppression after porosity -> worse than continuous suppression' prediction. Abiy dismantled a 23-year ethnic-federal (Tier 3 porosity) system; the framework predicts worse outcomes than continuous suppression. Mod 5 (capacity gate first) + Mod 6 (centrifugal/centripetal classifier) tested.
metadata.notes: Single-entity case (Ethiopia, with Tigray as the internal region). Recursive: Ethiopia having already lost Eritrea in 1993. All calls ordinal/directional; the framework explicitly does not claim to predict timing or trigger (Mod 3). WGI on legacy scale, recorded in notes.

pre_event.event_description: Abiy Ahmed (PM April 2018; Nobel Peace Prize 2019; rapprochement with Eritrea) dismantled the post-1995 ethnic-federal (Tier 3 porosity) system and centralized power, preceding the Tigray War (Nov 2020-Nov 2022) and the Amhara Fano insurgency (2023-).

context.neighbor_details: Eritrea as co-belligerent - Eritrean Defence Forces fought alongside ENDF against the TPLF and continued occupying border areas after Pretoria (non-signatories).

Ethiopia.notes: WGI Government Effectiveness negative, ~ -0.6 to -0.7 region (CEIC: -0.699 in 2017; legacy). Rule of Law negative (1996 min -0.97 per Run 2 data; still bottom-tier in 2018). Political Stability deeply negative (recurrent ethnic clashes, mass displacement). Resource rents low (not an oil rentier). FSI 2019 = 94.2 (most-improved that year, post-Abiy optimism); 2024 = 98.1 (6th most fragile in Africa). HDI low (medium-low tier). Derived: floor/near-floor P1; wide spread; high structural vulnerability.

a_trajectory_ranking.falsification_condition: Ethiopia stabilizes and improves on trajectory.

b_violence.prediction: 2018 floor P1 predicts high violence potential; LIVE (Mod 5) predicts a catastrophic outcome up front.
b_violence.agency_note: Mod8: this predicts RISK, not AGENCY

d_failure_dimension.prediction: Primary failure dimension P1 + P5 (stability); centrifugal (Mod 6 - fragmentation outward along ethnic/regional lines).
d_failure_dimension.note: Most exposed to post-hoc coding bias
d_failure_dimension.falsification_condition: Failure is centripetal or located on unrelated dimensions.

g_suppression_mechanism.classification: Tier 1 - the Tigray War was a military suppression of an autonomy/secession assertion. CRITICAL: re-suppression after porosity (dismantling the post-1995 ethnic-federal system) -> WORSE outcomes than continuous suppression.
g_suppression_mechanism.falsification_condition: Re-suppression yields milder outcomes than continuous suppression, or no suppression occurs.

h_substate_turbulence.prediction: Centrifugal failure - sequential regional fronts (Tigray -> Amhara -> Oromia).
h_substate_turbulence.falsification_condition: Turbulence remains contained to a single front.

Ethiopia.outcome_summary: Pretoria Agreement (2 Nov 2022) ended large-scale Tigray fighting but Eritrean troops and Amhara militias (non-signatories) remained. Tigray War (Nov 2020-Nov 2022) ~300,000-600,000 deaths (Ghent University's Jan Nyssen ~518,000 civilian; AU envoy Obasanjo ~600,000) - NYT: 'one of the world's bloodiest contemporary conflicts.' The 2023 dissolution of regional special forces triggered the Amhara Fano insurgency (Fano claims >80% of Amhara region); state of emergency Aug 2023-June 2024; FSI 2024 = 98.1; renewed Tigray clashes reported late January 2026.

a_trajectory.evidence: Deterioration and continued conflict (Tigray War, then Amhara insurgency); FSI 2024 = 98.1.

b_violence.evidence: Tigray War ~300,000-600,000 deaths; 'one of the world's bloodiest contemporary conflicts.'
b_violence.explanation: Confirmed directionally (both); LIVE's up-front catastrophic call (Mod 5) is more decision-useful. Framework disclaims timing/trigger.

c_convergence.evidence: Continued fragmentation pressure post-Pretoria via the Fano insurgency and ongoing Oromia conflict.
c_convergence.explanation: Continued fragmentation pressure as predicted (both versions).

d_failure_dimension.evidence: P1 + P5 (stability) failure; centrifugal form (sequential regional fronts).
d_failure_dimension.explanation: Confirmed; Mod 6's centrifugal classification adds value. [STRICT RE-CODE per run6 §3(d): post-hoc 'primary dimension' identification invites confirmation bias; coded PARTIAL under strict standards.]

e_fragment_count.explanation: Single-entity internal case; no fragment-count prediction scored.

f_reversal_risk.explanation: No standalone reversal-risk prediction scored for this case.

g_suppression.evidence: Tier 1 military suppression (Tigray War). CRITICAL re-suppression-after-porosity prediction CONFIRMED: dismantling the 23-year ethnic-federal porosity system preceded a war killing ~half a million and a second insurgency.
g_suppression.explanation: Strongest confirmation in the run; only LIVE names the mechanism explicitly. Re-suppression after porosity yielded worse outcomes than continuous suppression.

h_turbulence.evidence: Sequential Tigray -> Amhara -> Oromia fronts; Fano claims control of >80% of the Amhara region.
h_turbulence.explanation: Mod 6's centrifugal classifier correctly captured the form of failure (sequential regional fronts).

result_coding_reference.CONFIRMED: Prediction matched outcome on the specific dimension predicted
result_coding_reference.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: Direction correct but magnitude, form, or timing significantly different
result_coding_reference.NOT_APPLICABLE: Prediction type not relevant to this case

analysis.overall_assessment: Scored predictions all CONFIRMED (a, b, c, d, g, h) - including the CRITICAL re-suppression-after-porosity prediction. The strongest single confirmation in Run 3.
safeguards_triggered: Re-suppression after porosity (candidate Safeguard I; the run's central CONFIRMED prediction) - dismantling a 23-year ethnic-federal porosity system yielded worse outcomes than continuous suppression
Safeguard D - Eritrea as co-belligerent (EDF fought alongside ENDF)
Mod 5 (capacity gate first) - P1 below bottom-third Rule of Law -> catastrophic regardless of fragment count, called up front
Mod 6 (centrifugal/centripetal classifier) - centrifugal failure CONFIRMED via sequential Tigray -> Amhara -> Oromia fronts
Safeguard G - Tier 1 military suppression of an autonomy/secession assertion
analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: The 're-suppression after porosity -> worse outcomes' prediction is borne out with grim precision: dismantling a 23-year porosity system preceded a war killing on the order of half a million people and then spawned a second insurgency. Mod 6's centrifugal classifier added genuine predictive content about the form of failure beyond raw P1.
proposed_framework_modifications: Promote 're-suppression after porosity' from heuristic to a tested core prediction; flag any state dismantling a long-standing porosity/federal-accommodation system as elevated-risk.
analysis.baseline_impact: Confirms Mods 5 and 6; promotes a heuristic to a tested core prediction - a refinement, not a degradation of the baseline.
analysis.strict_recode_note: Strict re-code applied per run6 (post-hoc d-dimension -> PARTIAL; narrow-gap a-trajectory annotated with Mod4). Honest aggregate target ~62-78%.
analysis.phase3_note: Migrated to MI v1 + Data API references. a_trajectory/c_convergence auto-derived from real re-scored data (Mod4-gated); b/d/e/f/g/h preserved as judgment.
